name: Lyndaria 2: Dragon Passion
source:
The mysterious island of Lyndaria, home to vastly different tribes, has survived wars, cataclysms, and the fall of gods. Now its inhabitants must face a sudden, unforeseen threat, with Maya once again at the center of it all - a naive, deeply romantic explorer with a naive, sweet nature and the body of a porn star.

Follow one of four Paths or combine them as you see fit to unlock new abilities, overcome unexpected challenges, and unravel the island's final mystery.

The Path of the Hunt. For cunning and observant trackers who notice every detail.

The Path of the Great Tree. For peaceful healers who have forsaken violence for the greater good.

The Path of Freedom. For those who favor art and diplomacy over weapons.

The Path of the Night. For unwavering defenders of the island who refuse to divide magic into light and dark.

Uninvited guests arrive by airship from across the sea, a mysterious underwater city opens its gates to visitors, and a war-torn tribe of alfins searches for a new leader, all weaving together into an incredible web of events.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4605070/]Steam[/url]]
